subject.title: feat(agents): add iteration budget for agent loop safety

question: Should OpenClaw accept `agents.*.iterationBudget` plus the `onBeforeToolCallingRound`/`supportsIterationBudget` harness contract as the public loop-safety direction for this release?
rationale: The code path is plausible and proven, but it adds a new config surface and plugin harness contract whose names, defaults, and unsupported-harness fail-closed behavior are product/API choices rather than deterministic code-review facts.

options.title: Accept after conflict refresh
options.body: Resolve the current conflicts, keep the feature disabled by default, and merge once maintainers approve the config names and fail-closed unsupported-harness behavior.

options.title: Narrow before merge
options.body: Keep the internal hook but mark or scope the config as experimental until maintainers settle longer-term budget semantics across harnesses and plugins.

options.title: Defer direction
options.body: Close or pause this PR and leave the canonical loop-budget issue open until maintainers choose a broader resource-budget design.

recommendation.title: Accept after conflict refresh
recommendation.body: Resolve the current conflicts, keep the feature disabled by default, and merge once maintainers approve the config names and fail-closed unsupported-harness behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: sallyom is assigned and already carried the maintainer follow-up commits on this PR's budget semantics and proof.
